mapper.select: /** * searchComboBoxAprv : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.StmtOfRsMngMapper : 승인상태구분코드 조회 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('0','2','3')

/** * selectStmtOfRsMngDetail : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.StmtOfRsMngMapper : 사유서 상세조회 */ SELECT AA.WRTR_ID AS WRTR_ID , CC.ENFSN_NO AS ENFSN_NO , C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT , C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , AA.WRT_YMD AS WRT_YMD , AA.STOFRE_TTL_NM AS STOFRE_TTL_NM , AA.STOFRE_CN AS STOFRE_CN , AA.ATFINO AS ATFINO , DD.ATFINO AS SGNNG_ATFINO , '서명사진' AS SGNNG_ATCMFL_CL_NM , AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD , AA.RJCT_CS_CN AS RJCT_CS_CN , DD.STRG_COURS_NM || DD.STRG_FILE_NM AS FILE_INFO /*사진*/ FROM AYC320 AA , SAA200 BB , SCA100 CC , (SELECT * FROM SAB881 WHERE ATCMFL_CL_NM = '서명사진' AND FILE_STTS_SE_CD = 'N' ) DD WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.STOFRE_SN = #{stofreSn} AND AA.WRTR_ID = BB.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO AND AA.ATFINO = DD.ATFINO(+)
mapper.update: /** * deleteStmtOfRsMng : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.StmtOfRsMngMapper : 사유서관리 상세 삭제 */ UPDATE AYC320 AA /** 사이버상담 사유서 **/ SET AA.DEL_YN = 'Y' , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND AA.STOFRE_SN = #{stofreSn}
